  businesses(page: Int=1, pageSize: Int=10, isArchived: Boolean): BusinessConnection
  business(id: ID): Business
  user: User
  accountTypes: [AccountType!]!
  accountSubtypes: [AccountSubtype!]!
}
object RecurringInvoice implements BusinessNode,Node {
  business: Business!
  id: ID!
  internalId: String @deprecated
}
